summary.result: The findings provide valuable insights into ventilation characteristics in NV cattle barns and offer a foundation for improving ammonia emission measurement in NV buildings.
summary.background: Naturally ventilated (NV) cattle barns contribute significantly to national ammonia emissions, which are precursors to secondary particulate matter in the atmosphere.
summary.method: Measured ventilation rates were compared with estimates obtained from the CO 2 tracer gas method and the wind pressure-thermal buoyancy (WT) method to assess measurement reliability.
